document.about: Cree CR4T downlight spec sheet (Canada). Its photometry page sets ruled tables side by side, beside a polar chart, in two page columns parted by a vertical rule.

notes: #170: page 2 sets its margins further left than page 1, and opens with the title page 1 sets under its series name.

checks.issue: The title, restated as page 2’s running head, was a second SectionTitle.
The footer, on both pages 18pt apart across, stayed in the body twice: a Figure on page 1, a Paragraph on page 2.
